set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- Each primitive has analytic, POT differential, property, adversarial, and regression tests.
- Conservative/fast and serial/threaded paths are compared where applicable.
- Tolerances combine absolute and relative terms with rationale.
- Fixture provenance and POT version are recorded.
- A focused CI gate runs on every relevant change.
set.title: Certify the linear-OT substrate against independent references
